golden_answer: It is possible, but you will want to check with Chamberlain first to see if it requires a repeater kit.  In 2007 they introduced a new security scheme, and Homelink provided compatible equipment, but not all car manufacturers started using it right away.  In fact, as late as 2011 some car makers were still using the old Homelink technology that would not work with the new Chamberlain stuff "out of the box".  So you will want to confirm with both Chamberlain and Chevrolet if your year and model car will be able to transmit the new codes.  If not, there is an add-on repeater that will receive your Homelink signal and translate it to the new Chamberlain security codes, but it is about $50 retail itself.  However, this unit IS what you would be looking for to attach to your gate opener to receive signals from your Homelink or a remote.
